jobs.title: Unarmed Security Officer — Patrol & Public Safety
jobs.description:
Marksman Security Corporation is hiring an Unarmed Security Officer in Texas. You will patrol areas, maintain a visible presence, and document incidents while ensuring safety and customer service excellence. The role requires a Level II guard license and the ability to work weekends, evenings, and holidays.

Ideal candidates have security or customer service backgrounds, and a professional demeanor. The position involves reports, teamwork, and occasional physical activities to meet security needs.

jobs.title: Night Security Officer: Patrol, Access Control & Response
jobs.description: Sentry is hiring a Security Officer to support a 3rd shift team in a multi-property environment. You’ll patrol interiors and exteriors, monitor security systems, and manage access control for associates, contractors, and visitors.You’ll analyze emergencies, de‑escalate when needed, and prepare incident reports. The role requires night/weekend availability, a high school diploma, and CPR/AED/First Aid certification.#J-18808-Ljbffr
